title: Hydraulic Riveter
pages: Craft the controller with dispensers, iron blocks and tempered steel from the Quench Vat. Put an anvil directly beneath it, an iron block beneath each east and west dispenser, and a lectern directly above it. Face dispensers inward on its east and west sides only; the north and south sides stay open. Material update: crafting slot 2 (row-major 3x3) now requires a molybdenum ingot via forge:ingots/molybdenum; all existing progression gates remain required.

Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded riveting recipe. The riveter loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing anvil base, dispenser support, lectern lid, or outward/missing side dispenser stops operation.

The 22 exclusive riveting recipes have distinct jobs. Iron, netherite scrap, tempered steel and sealed steel plate still make the Riveted Brace required by the Press. Bearing Steel Stock makes four Tapered Roller Blanks; a forge:ingots/aluminum ingot makes eight Aluminum Rivets for the Rotary Screen. The other feeds cold-head useful stock: nine nuggets into one ingot, nine ingots or raw chunks into their matching storage block, nine diamonds, emeralds, lapis, redstone or coal into their matching block, four quartz or amethyst into their matching block, and three Annealed Copper into one Lightning Rod. These batches never yield more material than the corresponding vanilla craft. JEI shows the exact input count. Feed the formed controller by hand or through a sided item pipe; output collects from the bottom, and this machine needs no FE.

A riveted brace fills the bottom-left corner of the Press craft. The Press craft is now a swaged fitting, tempered steel and a Temper Glyph on top, tempered steel either side of a piston, then a riveted brace, tempered steel and a second swaged fitting along the bottom. The Hydraulic Riveter is a required pressing-tier apparatus; a bare iron ingot does not substitute for the brace.

Aluminum Rivets are a permanent fastener, unlike the removable Hex Bolt Set from the Coal Forge. The Rotary Screen controller needs two in its bottom corners to rivet its perforated drum plates. Real solid rivets carry shear far better than tension; aluminium alloy rivets are the aircraft norm, steel rivets the bridge and crane norm. Shank diameter, grip range and rivet alloy are not simulated.

Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
